messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] inference-prod GPU error-rate > 5% (30m avg). Paging oncall group.

anya: seeing it — spike from gpu-worker-7, started ~16:12 UTC
mike: I'm on it, will triage. Need to reduce PD chatter first.
maya: FYI CS saying a customer hit slower responses, flagging customer-impact. :raised_hand:
mike: quick plan: 1) temporary silence for noisy duplicate OOM alerts 2) add grouping/rate limits in alertmanager route 3) spin up transient dashboard for triage 4) handoff to next oncall after 1h monitor
sam: sounds good, post the commands you want run
mike: creating a 30m silence now for WorkerOOMs to stop repeat PD pages:
```
alertmanager silence --matchers 'alertname=WorkerOOM,env=prod' --duration=30m --created-by=mike
```
maya: creating transient dashboard -> https://redwood.app/dashboards/inf-prod/alert-fadeout (panel: error-rate by worker) :link:
sam: for routing/grouping, propose changing route to group by alertname+service and add a short rate limit. Example snippet to patch alertmanager config:
```
route:
  receiver: pagerduty
  group_by: ['alertname','service']
  group_wait: 60s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - matchers: ['alertname=WorkerOOM']
      receiver: pagerduty
      continue: false
      # add a small rate limiter via external config
```
julie-sre: agree on grouping, but do NOT suppress severity=critical alerts. Ensure a passthrough for `severity=critical` or `customer_impact=true`.
mike: will add filter: `severity != "info"` to allow critical through; grouping applies to transient OOMs only
maya: customer-impact note: one support ticket referenced a 30s slower tail latency, we alerted CS to escalate if more reports come in
sam: I'll open a follow-up ticket to make these changes permanent and add tests (dedupe rule, rate-limit, dashboard panel, rollback plan)
sam: checklist items I'll own: [PR alert routing changes, add dedupe rule, add 99th-latency panel, add automated silence runbook]
mike: monitoring: error-rate dropping after silence, down to ~1.2% in last 10m. PD noise reduced :thumbsup:
julie-sre: taking handoff for next hour. If errors don't drop back under 2%, escalate to infra and increase dbg logs on worker process
mike: leaving notes in runbook: `/runbooks/inference/errors` updated with transient-silence recommendation and grouping example
incident-bot: silence created for matcher 'WorkerOOM' by mike (30m)
maya: PR for dashboard and route patch incoming, will tag sam for review
sam: PR opened -> https://git.redwood/repo/alerts/pulls/123 (includes config + test harness)
mike: thanks — follow-up: we'll run a scheduled chaos small-burst test after config deploy to ensure no drop in signal quality
incident-bot: silence expired for matcher 'WorkerOOM' (created-by=mike)
julie-sre: re-enabled full PD flow, watching. Errors remain low, no fresh customer reports. Closing live thread, will capture tuning items in post-incident doc in #incidents.
mike: noted, I'll draft RCA in morning and link the postmortem to the ticket. Thanks all.
